question: What is the volume of a sphere of radius 3√2 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The volume of a sphere can be calculated directly using the formula V = 4/3 × π × r³.

Substitute r = 3√2 cm into the formula.

Volume = 4/3 × π × (3√2)³

Volume = 4/3 × π × 54√2 = 72√2π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 72√2π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the sphere (r) = 3√2 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a sphere = 4/3 × π × r³

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
• 
 
 
 
 r = 3√2 cm

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × π × (3√2)³

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × π × (3³ × (√2)³)

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × π × (27 × 2√2)

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × π × 54√2

⇒ Volume = 4 × 18√2 × π

⇒ Volume = 72√2π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 72√2π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is given by the formula 4 × π × r², where r is the radius.

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is half of a sphere. Its volume is given by 2/3 × π × r³.

Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The curved surface area of a hemisphere is 2 × π × r², and its total surface area is 3 × π × r².
